request: Read-only deploy preflight Vault and Astera v8; no service/config/secret mutation.

bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
printf 'DEPLOY_PREFLIGHT\n'
for name in libral-vault-libral-vault-1 astera-v8 astera-v8-evaluator astera-v8-evidence-search; do docker inspect "$name" --format '{{.Name}}|{{.State.Status}}|{{if .State.Health}}{{.State.Health.Status}}{{else}}none{{end}}|{{index .Config.Labels "com.docker.compose.project.working_dir"}}' 2>/dev/null || echo "$name|missing"; done
for dir in /home/admin1/projects/Libral-Vault /home/admin1/projects/libral-vault /home/admin1/Libral-Vault /home/admin1/projects/astera_v8 /home/admin1/projects/astera-v8 /home/admin1/astera_v8; do if [ -d "$dir/.git" ] || [ -f "$dir/.git" ]; then printf 'SOURCE %s ' "$dir"; git -C "$dir" rev-parse HEAD; fi; done
